items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My mother is Grace Louise Horn; I‘m sorry, Grace Louise Saunders.

ctx.x: What were your parents‘ names, and what are or were their occupations?
My mother is Grace Louise Horn; I‘m sorry, Grace Louise Saunders. My dad is Ernest Joviet [phonetic] Horn.
Were your parents native Washingtonians? If not, where were they from?
